description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for git's stash command, specifically testing the '--include-untracked' flag and related behaviors such as handling untracked, ignored, and tracked files, including various edge cases and options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, executes commands, and verifies success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a output file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a given file or directory is missing.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_file_not_empty
methods.description: Checks that a given file is not empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or streams for equality.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after test case.
